title: llm-d 1.0 Advances Open, Cost-Efficient AI Inference for Production Scale
script:
Project contributors led by IBM and Red Hat just released llm-d one point zero.
Google, CoreWeave, and NVIDIA also helped build this open framework for production scale.
It tackles the soaring cost of serving AI models at production scale.
The software delivers open and cost-efficient inference for enterprise systems.
Organizations can now run heavy workloads without traditional infrastructure limits.
Would your team adopt this open framework?

LINE 5: Mention specific workload types or performance multipliers instead of traditional infrastructure limits.
